about: Rounds aim4 eye wrote a strategy for, with the coach's correction and his grade. Unlike stratbook-notes.json these have a round behind them (the file is the round id in the replay library on aim4.io), so they can grade a model and become fine-tuning pairs.

pairs.label: Nemiga vs Lavked, Anubis, round 1
eye: robo: Hold water watching B Water. Push mid to B, be first on site.
Xant3r: Go A Water. Hold krimz watching A Main, then shift to Water.
KaiR0N-: Hold stairs watching m0NESY. Push mid to CT Con, go B.
khaN: Hold B Water watching Bridge. Push mid to CT Con.
SYPH0: Hold B Lobby watching B Main. Push B Main, be ready to support.
coach: robo: SF+P250. Drop p250. Go stairs and slowly shift right side water towards con. When out B, use smoke temple.
Xant3r: K. Go krimz instantly, hold A main. Go B con very late.
KaiR0N-: K. Go stairs and slowly shift right side water towards con.
khaN: K. Take p250. Stay m0NESY and hold con/mid peek first 5-10 sec. Then shift right side water towards con.
SYPHO: K. Lurk outside of B Main. Around 1.26, Push B Main & be ready to support.
feedback: Anubis is bugged in terms of interpreting con as mid.
If someone is holding something early, include the time for what to do next (when to stop doing something).
